trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a lump sum for covered running injuries to help with treatment, recovery or time off work, including 100% of the sum assured for cardiac arrest, coma of at least 48 hours, permanent loss of limb or sight, or death.

keyFigures.label: Cardiac arrest / coma / permanent loss / death
keyFigures.condition: within the covered duration of participation

keyFigures.label: Tendon rupture / ligament tear
keyFigures.value: 10% of sum assured with surgery; HK$5,000 without surgery

exclusionsOrConditions: Only the single highest-benefit injury is paid when multiple covered injuries occur in one accident.
The policy ends automatically once 100% of the sum assured is paid.
Injuries outside the covered duration, including warm-up before the assigned start time, are not covered.
